dimensions.assessment: Affects mariners, coastal communities, commercial and recreational shipping industries, and National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration personnel.
dimensions.evidence: enhance vessel safety... public and private stakeholders... Indian tribes

dimensions.assessment: Aims to improve maritime safety and forecasting tools through increased data collection, modeling, and advisories.
dimensions.evidence: enhance vessel safety and reduce the economic impact of coastal marine fog events

dimensions.assessment: The source text does not state or authorize specific funding amounts or appropriations.
Directs a specific agency project, stakeholder consultations, and a project plan without amending broader statutory codes.
dimensions.evidence: Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere shall conduct a project to improve forecasts of coastal marine fog

dimensions.assessment: Requires a project plan within one year and ongoing forecasting enhancements, though long-term funding authorization duration is unspecified.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Under Secretary shall develop a plan

missing_information: Authorized funding level or appropriation amount to carry out the project
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere to conduct a project to improve coastal marine fog forecasts, increase observational platforms, engage stakeholders and tribes, and develop a project plan.
